name: PentAGI
description: Executes penetration-testing workflows with autonomous agent teams that chain reconnaissance, exploitation, and reporting across established security tooling.

skills.name: Reconnaissance Automation
skills.description: Enumerates hosts, services, and attack surface using standard scanning tools driven by a planning agent.

skills.name: Exploitation Workflow
skills.description: Chains discovered findings into multi-step exploitation attempts inside an isolated containerized environment.

skills.name: Pentest Reporting
skills.description: Compiles findings, evidence, and remediation guidance into a structured report at the end of an engagement.
